content: स्खलनम् [स्खल्-भावे ल्युट्] .²1 Stumbling, slipping, tripping, falling down. .²2 Tottering. .²3 Deviating from the right course. .²4 Blundering, error, mistake. .²5 Failure, disappointment, unsuccessfulness. .²6 Stammering, blundering in speech or pronunciation, faltering. .²7 Trickling, dripping. .²8 Dashing against, clashing, collision; स्खलनमुखरभूरिस्रोतसो निर्झरिण्यः <ls>U. 2. 20</ls>; <ls>Mv. 5. 40</ls>. .²9 Mutual striking or rubbing together. .²10 Discharge, emission (of semen); <ls>Kull.</ls> on <ls>Ms. 5. 63</ls>.
